title: Views & Tag Helpers
description: Learn about Razor views, layouts, partial views, and tag helpers in ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: This module covers views and tag helpers in ASP.NET Core. You will learn how to create Razor views, use layouts for consistent page structure, work with partial views for reusable components, and leverage built-in and custom tag helpers.
whatYouLearn: Create and structure Razor views in ASP.NET Core
Use layouts, sections, and partial views
Understand the role of tag helpers in simplifying HTML
Use built-in tag helpers for forms, links, and inputs
Create custom tag helpers for reusable UI components
